acceptance: PROVISIONAL; numerical RMS pass with regional evidence limitations; not geographically or user accepted
limitations: Nine excluded checks give RMS 51.02 m, median 48.72 m, P95 73.76 m and maximum 77.27 m; all numerical bounds pass with geographic coverage qualifications.
Eight checks share islands with controls; Bald Rock adds one separate island. Strong local correlation limits interpretation as independent regional sampling.
Mainland northern interior and harbour heads lack accepted independent checks. Ocean coverage is preserved without implying independently measured accuracy at every location.
Egg main body outer north/south shores are sampled; internal fragmentation remains unvalidated. Mussell follows modern WACO20 connected coast, with its western connection unvalidated.
Generalized coastal observations use 18 px working source uncertainty. Erosion, tidal shore and small offshore rocks can change.
